name: Cloudflare Agents Starter
description: Starter chat agent for Cloudflare Workers with tools, human approval, task scheduling and image input.
whatItDoes: It provides a working chat agent that can check weather, detect time zones, calculate with user approval and schedule tasks, as a base for agents deployed on Cloudflare.
howItWorks: The agent is built with Cloudflare's Agents SDK and runs on Workers with a React chat UI. It uses Workers AI by default so no model key is required, and can connect to MCP servers or be switched to other providers.

requirements.name: Cloudflare account
requirements.description: Authentication is needed even locally because Workers AI runs remotely

models: Workers AI by default; OpenAI or Anthropic optional
